name: Greedy Meshing for Voxel Faces
aliases: Greedy meshing for complex voxel data
definition: A technique to reduce the number of triangles in voxel rendering by merging adjacent coplanar voxel faces into larger quads. It differs from standard greedy meshing by comparing voxel faces (which may have varying attributes like type, transparency, or lighting) rather than just voxel existence.
